jobs.occupation: Kvalitetssikringsmedarbejder søges til Firesafe Danmark A/S
jobs.description:
Kvalitetssikringsmedarbejder søges til Firesafe Danmark A/S

Har du øje for kvalitet, teknisk forståelse og lyst til at arbejde tæt på byggeprocessen?

Hos Firesafe Danmark A/S søger vi to kvalitetssikringsmedarbejdere til at styrke vores kvalitetssikring inden for passiv brandsikring og isolering. Vi søger strukturerede og kvalitetsbevidste medarbejdere med teknisk forståelse.

Du får en varieret hverdag, hvor du kombinerer praktiske kvalitetstilsyn på byggepladsen med teknisk opfølgning og dokumentation. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med montører, projektledere og øvrige kolleger.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

·         Udføre løbende kvalitetstilsyn og kontrol af passiv brandsikring og isoleringsarbejde.

·         Kontrollere, at arbejdet udføres i overensstemmelse med tekniske tegninger, montagevejledninger og gældende krav.

·         Identificere kvalitetsafvigelser og følge op på nødvendige udbedringer.

·         Udarbejde og vedligeholde kvalitetsdokumentation samt registrere og følge op på opgaver i Dalux og BIM.

·         Vejlede montører i korrekte arbejdsmetoder og tekniske løsninger, herunder demonstrere korrekt udførelse.

·         Samarbejde med ledelsen om tekniske afklaringer, koordinering og kvalitetsopfølgning.

Vi forventer, at du:

•         Har teknisk forståelse og interesse for kvalitetssikring.

•         Kan læse og forstå bygningstegninger og teknisk dokumentation.

•         Arbejder selvstændigt, systematisk og følger dine opgaver til dørs.

•         Kan kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk, både mundtligt og skriftligt.

•         Er fortrolig med digitale værktøjer og har lyst til at arbejde med kvalitetsdokumentation.

•         Kan vejlede montører og følge op på kvaliteten af det udførte arbejde.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har:

•         Erfaring med kvalitetssikring og kontrol i byggebranchen.

•         Kendskab til passiv brandsikring, isolering eller lignende teknisk arbejde.

•         Erfaring med Dalux og BIM.

•         Gode danskkundskaber og kendskab til flere sprog.

Der stilles ikke krav om en bestemt uddannelse, dog er det en fordele hvis man har en teknisk baggrund. 

Vi tilbyder

•         Fast fuldtidsstilling på minimum 37 timer om ugen.

•         Tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt eller efter aftale.

•         Løn efter kvalifikationer og erfaring samt pension og øvrige vilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst.

•         Firmatelefon, computer og andet relevant udstyr i forbindelse med arbejdet.

•         En varieret arbejdsdag med både praktiske og administrative opgaver.

•         Et arbejdsmiljø med gode kolleger og mulighed for faglig udvikling.

Om Firesafe Danmark A/S

Firesafe Danmark A/S arbejder med passiv brandsikring og relaterede tekniske ydelser på byggeprojekter. Vi bidrager til at beskytte mennesker, bygninger og værdier gennem korrekt udførelse og dokumentation af brandtekniske løsninger.

Hos os bliver du en del af en organisation, hvor kvalitet, samarbejde og ansvarlighed er i fokus.

Ansøgning

Lyder stillingen som noget for dig?

Send dit CV og en kort beskrivelse af din motivation for at søge jobbet til info@firesafe.dk

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Søren Christiansen soeren.christiansen@firesafe.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

 

  

Quality Assurance Employee Wanted at Firesafe Danmark A/S

Do you have an eye for detail, a strong technical understanding, and a passion for ensuring high quality workmanship on construction sites?

Firesafe Danmark A/S is looking to recruit two Quality Assurance Employees to strengthen our quality assurance team within passive fire protection and insulation works.

In this role, you will combine on-site quality inspections with technical follow-up and documentation. You will work closely with installers, project managers, and other members of the project team to ensure that installations meet the required quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

•         Conduct regular QA/QC inspections of passive fire protection and insulation works on-site.

•         Verify that installations comply with approved drawings, installation instructions, project specifications, and applicable requirements.

•         Identify non-conformities and follow up on corrective actions to ensure proper close-out.

•         Prepare and maintain quality documentation, inspection records, and reports, including the registration and follow-up of quality-related issues in Dalux and BIM models.

•         Provide technical guidance to installers on approved installation methods and demonstrate correct workmanship when required.

•         Coordinate with the project team regarding technical clarifications, site activities, and quality-related matters.

About You

We are looking for a responsible, structured, and solution-oriented individual with strong attention to detail. You are comfortable working both on construction sites and in a site office, and you can communicate effectively with different trades and project stakeholders.

We expect you to:

•         Have a good technical understanding and a strong interest in quality assurance and quality control.

•         Be able to read and interpret construction drawings and technical documentation.

•         Work independently, systematically, and take ownership of your tasks.

•         Communicate effectively in English or Danish, both verbally and in writing.

•         Be comfortable using digital tools for inspections and quality documentation.

•         Be confident in guiding installers and following up on the quality of completed work.

 

It would be an advantage if you have:

•         Previous experience in QA/QC, quality inspections, or construction site supervision.

•         Knowledge of passive fire protection, insulation, or similar construction activities.

•         Experience working with Dalux and BIM.

•         Hands-on construction site experience, including providing technical guidance to installers.

•         Good Danish language skills and knowledge of additional languages.

A specific educational background is not required. We value relevant practical experience, technical understanding, and the right attitude.

What We Offer

•         A permanent, full-time position with a minimum of 37 working hours per week.

•         Start date as soon as possible or by agreement.

•         Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience, including pension and other employment benefits in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and employment contract.

•         Company phone and the possibility of a company vehicle, depending on project requirements.

•         A varied workday combining on-site inspections with office-based QA/QC activities.

•         A supportive and informal working environment with opportunities for professional development.

About Firesafe Danmark A/S

Firesafe Danmark A/S specialises in passive fire protection and related technical services within the construction industry.

Our work contributes to protecting people, buildings, and assets by ensuring that fire protection systems are correctly installed, inspected, and documented in accordance with project specifications and applicable requirements.

You will become part of a team where quality, teamwork, and accountability are at the core of our daily operations.

How to Apply

Interested in joining our team?

Please submit your CV along with a short description of your motivation for applying to info@firesafe.dk

If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact Søren Christiansen soeren.christiansen@firesafe.dk for further information.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Product Manager, data & AI - SitaWare Insight
jobs.description:
**Product Manager, data & AI – SitaWare Insight

**_What if your operational experience could shape the data and AI capabilities behind better decisions in the battlefield? Join SitaWare Insight as Product Manager, and turn real-world defence and intelligence needs into product features, compelling customer demonstrations and meaningful improvements for soldiers, staff officers and NATO customers.

_**The job

**As Product Manager for SitaWare Insight, you will work alongside our Business Product Manager and development teams to turn operational needs into concrete product features. You will be the voice of the customer and end-user, guiding the team’s day-to-day work and helping us to show what our data and AI platform can do for command and control (C2).

In short, you can look forward to:

• guiding the development team’s day-to-day work, translating operational requirements into concrete features for SitaWare Insight

• representing the voice of the customer and end-user, including prioritising fixes and change requests through our change control boards

• using Insight’s own toolset – dashboards, data import and agents – to build examples that show customers and colleagues what is possible

• supporting the sales team with product expertise, customer visits and proposal input while helping the marketing department to create product collateral

• representing Systematic at conferences, trade shows and user forums, and presenting to customers on-site

The position requires regular international travel to customers and Systematic offices, approximately 20–30 days each year.

**Joining the team

**Based in Copenhagen, you will be close to the development teams building SitaWare Insight, while collaborating closely with Product Management colleagues in Aarhus. Alongside our Business Product Manager, who owns the product roadmap, you will provide operational input for the team’s daily implementation and help keep development aligned with user needs and product priorities. Together, you will be part of a collaborative team committed to turning data and AI into solutions that make a tangible difference across the defence sector from staff at headquarters to decision-makers in the field.

**Your Qualifications

**You bring a solid background from the armed forces or intelligence services – for example as an officer, NCO or in a role such as an information manager – or several years of hands-on experience working directly with defence or intelligence customers as a supplier of data or information products or systems. This operational experience is essential, as it enables you to understand the realities our end-users face and to translate their needs into concrete product decisions.

We are also looking for:

• a genuine interest in how data and AI support C2, and the ability to translate this into product direction. You do not need to be able to write code, but you must be able to engage confidently in technical dialogue with data engineers and architects

• excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate confidently and effectively in English

At COWI, we are seeking a Junior Structural Engineer to support our team on major infrastructure projects. You will join a highly skilled group of engineers delivering solutions for bridges, immersed tunnels, underground structures and other complex civil engineering projects. Working alongside experienced specialists, you will contribute to projects that improve how people and societies connect.

Turn challenges into sustainable solutions

As a Junior Structural Engineer, you will contribute to the design and analysis of complex infrastructure projects from early concept development through detailed design and construction support. You will work closely with colleagues across disciplines and geographies, gaining practical experience and developing your technical skills and engineering judgement.

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Performing structural analysis and design of civil engineering structures

• 
Working with FEM and structural analysis tools

• 
Preparing calculations, technical documentation and design deliverables

• 
Collaborating with structural, geotechnical, BIM and other engineering disciplines

• 
Contributing to digital engineering initiatives, including automated workflows and parametric design solutions

• 
Participating in technical discussions, reviews and knowledge-sharing activities within the team and structural engineering community

Your skills. Our team. Together, we design the future.

We are looking for a motivated engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges and is eager to develop within a collaborative and international environment. You combine a strong interest in structural engineering with curiosity about new technologies, digital tools, and innovative ways of solving engineering problems. A Master degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related discipline

0-5 years of professional experience in structural or civil engineering.

Knowledge with finite element modelling (FEM) and structural analysis

Knowledge of concrete design principles and relevant design standards such as for instance Eurocode 2

Interest or experience in automated workflows and parametric design tools, such as Grasshopper

Interest or experience in AI, programming or engineering automation is an advantage

Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to organise own work while contributing actively to a team

A place to work and so much more

jobs.occupation: S&OP Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Are you a self-starting transformation driver, strategic thinker and pragmatic deliverer, who turns a long-term vision and complex objectives into step-by-step reality and a clear path forward? Do you possess strong project management skills with the ability to translate a multi-year roadmap into smaller bricks and actionable wins, keeping momentum high as requirements evolve? Are you a gifted communicator who breaks down silos and unites cross-functional teams around a lean way of working? Do you possess the business acumen and analytical skills to spot risks and interdependencies across projects and complex organizations? **If so, join us as S&OP Project Manager!

**What The Job Is ...

**We have embarked on a multi-year, enterprise-wide transformation program through 2030 to support the long-term growth and industrialization of Satair and Airbus Material Services. We are redesigning the Processes, Methods, Tools and Data (PMTD) across various domains and organizations, for a lean operating model powered by a Fit-to-Standard modern ERP and harmonized processes.

One of the key cornerstones of this transformation is the deployment of an integrated end-to-end Sales and Operations Planning process across various businesses.

In your position as S&OP Project Manager you will be part of a cross-functional and cross-organizational project team. In addition to designing and implementing the TO BE S&OP Processes, Methods, Tools and Data (PMTD), you will act as the key point between our external consultancy partners, internal business stakeholders and the broader enterprise transformation program.

Travel required: 15%

**How you will contribute to the team:

**

• PMTD and Architecture Design and Implementation: Design the target Process, Method, Tools and Data covering customer demand, supply capacity and feedback loop mechanisms, including scenario-planning and escalation protocols across and between businesses. Partner with IT and Digital to define the future ERP requirements for S&OP, ensuring a seamless and integrated architecture between Processes and Tools.

• Project Management: Define project roadmap, translate long-term ambition into short-term milestones, maintain project governance, ensure progress towards deliverables, identify and proactively manage interdependencies and risks.

• Stakeholder Alignment Beyond Silos: Proactively identify and engage senior stakeholders across functions and organizations in a complex environment to drive alignment on future ways of working, overcome organizational friction and secure global process simplification and standardization.

• Consultant Management: Lead the relationship with external consultants, steering their deliverables to shape our target S&OP Processes, Methods, Tools and Data (PMTD). Validate consultant proposals and recommendations against business needs and context, ensuring designs are scalable and implementable across various business units.

• Strategic Escalations & Executive Briefings: Prepare executive-ready decks, high-impact decision dossiers, trade-off analysis, recommendations and progress updates for executive forums and the central Transformation steering.

• ERP Fit-to-Standard (F2S): Drive business readiness and stakeholder participation across multi-functional teams for F2S workshops to design the future ERP requirements. Safeguard S&OP scope requirements within the central ERP system, ensuring seamless alignment between S&OP process and the future ERP capabilities.

• Ad-Hoc Initiatives: Lead other potential initiatives or projects related to S&OP.

**Candidate Profile & Qualificatio ns

**Core experience and background **:

**

• Education: MSc/MA in Business, Economics, Strategy, Finance, Supply Chain or a related field

• Experience and Track record: 5-8+ years of experience in Project Management, Supply Chain, Management Consulting or equivalent. Proven track record in project management, S&OP deployment, leading cross-functional teams or enterprise process redesigns.

• Methodologies: Mastery of structured project management and business process mapping.

• Languages: Fluent English is mandatory. Good command of French or German is a plus.

**Work style and soft skills:

**

• You are self-driven, proactive and autonomous

• You can translate complex long-term objectives into clear sequential steps. You have a strong focus on driving progress and delivering results, ensuring execution momentum even when requirements change.

• You can balance strategic thinking with tactical execution

• You are analytical, and enjoy understanding the intricacies of how things work

• You are excellent at stakeholder management and can navigate large organizations with ease

• You are a natural communicator and consensus builder, with the ability to understand and demystify complex concepts to obtain stakeholder buy-in

• You have the ability to influence senior leaders, negotiating trade-offs and overcoming organizational resistance.

• You have excellent analytical skills and business acumen, able to translate complex information into clear recommendations

**What does your next challenge look like?

**At Satair, we believe in sustainable aviation that allows people to travel and connect across the globe.

We are on a mission to provide world class material solutions that keep aircraft flying and extend their lifespan.

In Satair, you can challenge the status quo, pioneer new ways of working, and generate real value for airlines and suppliers worldwide.

Being part of the Airbus family gives us the opportunity to live a global mindset, working in international teams and collaborating across functions, sites and cultures.

If you want to work as one team embracing a can-do attitude in a demanding environment, then we offer a great place to explore, learn, and grow.

Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company!

**About SATAIR

**Satair offers first class material management solutions in the aftermarket business of the aviation industry. We are working to be the most customer-centric organization in providing commercial aviation spares parts to make the world continue flying. We are constantly taking customer experience to new levels by improving how we fulfill and deliver customers’ orders quickly and accurately, anywhere in the world. To meet this goal, Satair is continually striving to innovate and provide best-in-class service levels by pioneering new products and services in a fast growing business environment.

With our global functional organization spanning across 11 different sites and locations worldwide with more than 1.800 people and a turnover of $3.3 billion, you will be part of a truly global family.

Our customers have the ultimate goal to operate their fleet and our Airbus aircraft safely, efficiently in a cost-time-quality effective manner and of course with the expected comfort level for their customers. We at Satair do everything to support our customers in this.

If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our website www.SATAIR.com or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel at www.youtube.com/sataircompany !

**At SATAIR, you will find much more than a job - we offer you the possibility of growing both your personal and professional capacities in a fun, supportive and informal working environment, where you will be encouraged to engage, share knowledge and ideas.

jobs.occupation: PhD fellowship in cerebral interoception at Center for Translational Neuromedicine
jobs.description:
We are offering a PhD fellowship in cerebral interoception commencing 15 February 2027 or after agreement.

  Our group and research
 Center for Translational Neuromedicine focuses on developing new approaches for examining and treating neurological diseases, primarily using the tools of physiology and imaging coupled with cell and gene therapy. Our emphasis is on using these technologies to enable neural and glial cell replacement in the adult brain and spinal cord, as a means of both disease modeling and therapeutic repair.

  Center for Translational Neuromedicine currently has 55 employees and students and is divided into five labs. CTN is characterized by a highly ambitious research environment. The Center is highly interdisciplinary and has many international collaborators. The PhD-student will be part of the Kaag Rasmussen lab, Division of Pain Volume Transmission. Being part of the Kaag Rasmussen lab offers an opportunity to work in an in vivo lab engaged in the neuroscience of pain signalling, focusing on transgenic animal models, behaviour, in vivo imaging and omics technologies. 

  Project description
 In this PhD project we will characterize the functional and molecular characteristics of meningeal sensory neurons. In all the body, different sensory neuron classes project to various targets and are fine-tuned at a functional and molecular level to detect and transmit sensory information from the target organ to the central nervous system. The sensory neurons projecting to dura mater and pia mater have been known to play a role in headache pathology, yet very little is known regarding their functional and molecular properties. This PhD project will dissect out which sensory neuron subtypes project to dura and pia mater, what stimuli they respond to, and define their molecular identity. The aim is to identify what subclasses of meningeal sensory projection neurons are involved in headache experience, and to identify new molecular targets within these sensory neurons that could provide basis for headache therapeutics in the future. To achieve this we will use a combination of in vivo imaging of transgene animals expressing various fluorophores that be used as indicators of neuronal activity and single cell transcriptomics.

  Principal supervisor is Martin Kaag Rasmussen, Center for Translational Neuromedicine, martin.rasmussen@sund.ku.dk.

  Start: 15 February 2027 or after agreement

  Duration: 3 years as a PhD student

  Job description
 Your key tasks as a PhD student at SUND are:

   	
• Carrying through an independent research project under supervision.    	
• Completing PhD courses or other equivalent education corresponding to approximately 30 ECTS points. 	
• Participating in active research environments including a stay at another research team. 	
• Obtaining experience with teaching or other types of dissemination related to your PhD project 	
• Teaching and disseminating your knowledge. 	
• Writing a PhD thesis on the grounds of your project   PhD Programme Description
 The PhD programme is a three-year full-time research education within the framework of the 5+3 scheme, intended for candidates holding a relevant academic degree within the project’s subject area (e.g., Neuroscience).

  Qualifications
 If you have completed your academic education in Denmark, the admission to the PhD programme requires a relevant Master’s degree (equivalent to 180 ECTS BSc + 120 ECTS MSc).

  If you have an academic education from abroad, you must have either a degree equivalent to a Danish master's degree (180 ETCS + 120 ECTS MSc), or at a minimum, a bachelor’s degree equivalent to a Danish bachelor's degree (180 ECTS) and be academically qualified at master's level.

  As part of the assessment of whether you meet the educational requirements, you must also achieve a positive academic evaluation and be assessed as the best qualified for the position.

  Other important criteria are:

   	
• The grade point average achieved 	
• Professional qualifications relevant to the PhD project 	
• Previous publications 	
• Relevant work experience 	
• Other professional activities 	
• A curious mind-set with a strong interest in pain and headache as well as basic neuroscience 	
• Language skills   Place of employment
 The place of employment is at the Center for Translational Neuromedicine, Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and state-of-the-art equipment

  Terms of employment 
 The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

  The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of 3 years. The start date is 15 February 2027 or after agreement.

  The employment is conditioned upon the applicant’s successful enrolment as a PhD student at the Graduate School at the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. This requires submission and acceptance of an application for the specific project formulated by the applicant. The PhD study must be completed in accordance with The Ministerial Order on the PhD programme (2013) and the Faculty’s rules on achieving the degree. 

  Salary, pension and terms of employment are in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. Depending on seniority, the monthly salary starts at approximately 31,800 DKK/Roughly 4,250 EUR (August 2026 level) plus pension.

  You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

  Questions
 For specific information about the PhD fellowship, please contact the principal supervisor.

  General information about PhD studies at the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences is available at the Graduate School’s website.

  Application procedure
 Your application must be submitted electronically by clicking ‘Apply now’ below. The application must include the following documents in PDF format: 

  1. Motivated letter of application (max. one page)

  2. CV incl. education, experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position

  3. Certified copy of degree diploma(s) relevant to a Danish master’s or bachelor’s degree depending on whether you completed your education in Denmark or abroad (read more under Qualifications). If not completed, a certified/signed copy of a recent transcript of records or a written statement from the institution or supervisor is accepted. We encourage you to read more in the assessment database. Please note that we might ask you to obtain an assessment of your education performed by the Ministry of Higher Education and Science.

  4. Publication list (if possible)

  Application deadline: 17 November 2026, 23.59 CET

  We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

  The further process 
 After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor.

  The assessor makes a non-prioritized assessment of the academic qualifications and experience with respect to the above-mentioned area of research, techniques, skills and other requirements listed in the advertisement.

  Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself.

  You find information about the recruitment process here.

  The applicants will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

   

  The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

jobs.occupation: PhD Student in PHA Processing and Modification by Reactive Extrusion - DTU Chemical Engineering
jobs.description:
If you are excited by doing reactive extrusion, online monitoring and materials characterization for renewable polymer systems such as PHAs, this could be the PhD project for you.

Responsibilities and qualifications
The objective of this PhD project is to develop next-generation polyhydroxyalkanoate (PHA) compounds through advanced polymer processing, formulation, and reactive extrusion. The project will focus on improving processability and performance while establishing relationships between formulation, processing history, polymer structure, and final material properties. 

As a PhD student, you will prepare and process new PHA formulations using extrusion-based methods, investigate reactive processing and novel additive concepts, and evaluate compounds for injection moulding, extrusion, and blow moulding. You will combine offline polymer characterization with online and in-line analytical methods to monitor changes during processing and support adaptive control of composition and process conditions. 

We are therefore looking for candidates with: 

• Practical experience in polymer processing, preferably extrusion or reactive extrusion, obtained through MSc studies or equivalent research activities. 
• A strong interest in biopolymers (natural polymers), polymer formulation, compounding, and structure-property-processing relationships. 
• Hands-on experience with polymer characterization, particularly FTIR, rheology, DSC, TGA, and NMR. 
• Experience with Raman spectroscopy, online analysis, or process monitoring, which will be considered an advantage. 
• Experience with injection moulding, film or profile extrusion, or blow moulding, which will be considered an advantage. 
• The ability to plan experimental work independently and collaborate effectively across polymer chemistry, processing, and analytical disciplines. 
• An interest in teaching and supervising student projects as part of the PhD programme. 
The project is expected to generate new knowledge on the processing and stabilization of PHA-based materials and to deliver high-performance compounds designed for safe handling, demanding processing routes, and environmentally benign end-of-life scenarios. 

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

Assessment
The assessment of the applications will be conducted immediately after the deadline, and we expect to call for interviews in November.

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms 
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures. 

The period of employment is 3 years.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information 
Further information may be obtained from Anders E. Daugaard, adt@kt.dtu.dk. 

You can read more about DTU Chemical engineering at www.kt.dtu.dk.

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 24 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
• A table providing an overview of your prior experience in processing and synthesis (method and application) and characterization methods you are familiar with (both in practice and theory)
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Chemical Engineering conducts experiments at microscale, at laboratory scale, in pilot facilities and at industrial scale. The department enjoys a very close and mutually beneficial relationship with Danish-based industrial enterprises as well as leading universities and enterprises from all over the world.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.occupation: Staff Scientist in Antipathogenic Drug Research
jobs.description:
The Department of Immunology and Microbiology is looking for a highly motivated and independent Staff Scientist in Antipathogenic Drug Research. The position is expected to commence on 1st of February 2027 and its duration is limited to two years.

  Our research
 The Department of Immunology and Microbiology at University of Copenhagen is a unique interdisciplinary research flagship exploring the biology of pathogenic microbes and our immune system, with the aim of improving population health.

  Your job
 The Staff Scientist will work on a project concerning the development of chemical compounds that inhibit production of toxins in Staphylococcus aureus and impede the pathogenic effects of the bacterium in atopic dermatitis. This entails:

   	
• Plan, prioritize and carry out the project in accordance with its scientific objectives, milestones, budget and reporting requirements. 	
• Coordinate project activities with laboratory technical staff and internal and external collaborators and supervise students or junior researchers where relevant. 	
• Maintain research documentation and data-management practices and ensure compliance with laboratory safety, research-integrity and relevant institutional requirements. 	
• Prepare scientific publications, conference presentations, seminars, workshops, reports and relevant outreach activities. 	
• Develop follow-up research directions, collaborations and applications for further competitive research funding.   Because the work is research-driven, its detailed timing and sequence cannot be fully predetermined. Within the agreed scientific and institutional framework, the Staff Scientist will independently determine day-to-day priorities, experimental design and methods, the sequence of experiments and analyses, and the coordination of collaborations.

  Profile
 We are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic Staff Scientist with the following competencies and experience:

  Qualifications and Expectations 

   	
• A MSc/PhD degree in molecular microbiology or a closely related field. 	
• Experience in antipathogenic drug research. 	
• Experience in working with Staphylococcus aureus. 	
• Experience with diverse molecular biology techniques. 	
• Experience with transcriptomics and bioinformatic tools and workflows. 	
• Experience with preparing scientific reports, manuscripts and presentations. Previous scientific publications are considered an advantage.  	
• Experience in supervising students, junior researchers and technical staff. 	
• Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a research environment within agreed milestones and budgets. 	
• Good written and oral communication skills in English.   Place of employment
 The place of employment is the Costerton Biofilm Center, Department of Immunology and Microbiology, University of Copenhagen, Copenhagen, Denmark. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in a dynamic and international research environment, with access to facilities and expertise in molecular medical microbiology.

  Terms of employment
 The average weekly working time is 37 hours.

  The position is fixed-term for two years, from 1 February 2027 to 31 January 2029.

  The position is classified as Staff Scientist (AC-TAP). Employment will be under The Circular on the Collective Agreement concerning Academics in the state sector concluded between the Danish Ministry of Finance and Akademikernes (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations). The monthly salary will be based on the number of years of work experience (seniority) and there will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish). The applicable pension contribution will be in accordance with the relevant collective agreement.

  Application
 If you are interested in the position, please submit your electronic application, including attachments, via the UCPH Job Portal (click the “Apply for position” link at the bottom of the job posting).
 Your application should be submitted in English and include:

   	
• A letter of application addressing the requirements, maximum one page. 	
• Curriculum vitae. 	
• A certified or signed copy of certificate(s) of education.   The application deadline is 17 November 2026.

  Interviews are expected to be held shortly after the application deadline.

  The University wishes to reflect the diversity of the surrounding society and encourages all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. 
 
 Questions
 For further information regarding the position, please contact Tim Tolker-Nielsen at ttn@sund.ku.dk.
  

  The University of Copenhagen has established a new shared administrative organizational structure, which is currently being implemented. This entails ongoing changes and the development of, among other things, workflows and interfaces for collaboration.
